title: Archer Aviation to acquire three aviation technology units from Boeing
excerpt: Archer Aviation (NYSE:ACHR) shares jumped 16% Monday after the company announced a deal to acquire Boeing Co (NYSE:BA, XETRA:BCO)’s Wisk Aero, SkyGrid and In...
content_html:
Archer Aviation (NYSE:ACHR) shares jumped 16% Monday after the company announced a deal to acquire Boeing Co (NYSE:BA, XETRA:BCO)'s Wisk Aero, SkyGrid and Insitu subsidiaries, expanding its presence across autonomous flight, electric vertical takeoff and landing (eVTOL) aircraft, unmanned aircraft systems and air traffic management.

The companies said they have signed definitive agreements for the transaction, which is expected to combine technologies developed across aerospace autonomy, eVTOL aircraft and unmanned systems.

The deal is expected to give Archer an expanded platform spanning commercial aerospace, defense and air traffic management.

Wisk has developed autonomous eVTOL aircraft and has conducted more than 1,700 flight tests across six generations of aircraft, while Insitu develops uncrewed aircraft systems used for intelligence, surveillance and reconnaissance. SkyGrid provides ground-based air traffic management technology designed to support automated airspace.

Together, the three businesses have nearly two million combined flight hours, according to the companies. Archer said their autonomy technologies are expected to contribute to its ZEE artificial intelligence platform.

Archer founder and CEO Adam Goldstein described the transaction as a major step toward expanding the company beyond its existing air taxi business.

"This is a watershed moment for Archer and the future of physical AI in aerospace and defense. This is the next big step forward in becoming a diversified platform, rapidly growing our revenue base and bringing scale to our business," Goldstein said.

The transaction will also include a collaboration and technology-sharing arrangement between Boeing and Archer. Boeing will retain access to Wisk's core autonomous flight technology for its current and next-generation commercial and defense aircraft.

Boeing will also retain strategic exposure to the businesses through its stake in Archer, while shifting its current and future investment focus toward its core operations.

"This transaction is a win-win for Boeing and Archer," said Brian Yutko, Boeing's vice president of Commercial Airplanes Product Development.

"It allows Wisk, SkyGrid and Insitu to accelerate capability development and time to market while ensuring Boeing capitalizes on its investments in these technologies over the past two decades through continued development in our core businesses."

Shares of Boeing were up 0.5% at about $234 on the news.

content_html_zh:
Archer Aviation (NYSE:ACHR) 周一宣布收购波音公司 (NYSE:BA, XETRA:BCO) 旗下 Wisk Aero、SkyGrid 和 Insitu 子公司的交易，该公司股价周一上涨 16%，从而扩大其在自动飞行、电动垂直起降 (eVTOL) 飞机、无人机系统和空中交通管理领域的业务。

两家公司表示，他们已经签署了此次交易的最终协议，预计该交易将结合航空航天自主、电动垂直起降飞机和无人驾驶系统领域开发的技术。

该交易预计将为 Archer 提供一个涵盖商业航空、国防和空中交通管理的扩展平台。

Wisk 开发了自动电动垂直起降飞机，并在六代飞机中进行了 1,700 多次飞行测试，而 Insitu 则开发用于情报、监视和侦察的无人驾驶飞机系统。 SkyGrid 提供地面空中交通管理技术，旨在支持自动化空域。

据公司称，这三项业务合计飞行小时数接近 200 万小时。 Archer 表示，他们的自主技术预计将为其 ZEE 人工智能平台做出贡献。

Archer 创始人兼首席执行官 Adam Goldstein 表示，此次交易是公司向现有空中出租车业务拓展的重要一步。

“对于 Archer 以及航空航天和国防领域物理人工智能的未来来说，这是一个分水岭。 这是成为多元化平台、快速扩大我们的收入基础并扩大我们业务规模的又一大进步，”戈德斯坦说。

该交易还将包括波音和阿彻之间的合作和技术共享安排。 波音公司将为其当前和下一代商用和国防飞机保留使用 Wisk 核心自主飞行技术的权利。

波音还将通过其持有的Archer股份保留对这些业务的战略投资，同时将当前和未来的投资重点转向其核心业务。

波音商用飞机产品开发副总裁布莱恩·尤特科 (Brian Yutko) 表示：“这项交易对波音和 Archer 来说是双赢。”

“它使 Wisk、SkyGrid 和 Insitu 能够加快能力开发和上市时间，同时确保波音通过我们核心业务的持续发展，充分利用过去二十年来对这些技术的投资。”

消息传出后，波音公司股价上涨 0.5%，至 234 美元左右。
